external_collaboration.evidence_quote: LAS VEGAS – (BUSINESS WIRE) – Amerigroup Nevada and MedTrans LLC dba WELL CARE Services have partnered to offer Medicaid members with chronic health problems, tailored integrated healthcare services at WELL CARE Services’ new facility in Las Vegas. The services are available to adults, and include onsite face-to-face primary care and telehealth exams, housing coordination, transportation to community resources and social services as well as therapy for mental illness and medication management.
